items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: H.E. Schoonover, an agent, and he came in and says I'd like to carry you on a tour of the northwest... I signed an agreement with him and we went on and made the trip.

ctx.x: Yeah. We had Rene Hall and we began to add a piece or two and I got a young man out of Wichita, Kansas, Delma Willis and Bob Graham on tenor and a fellow came, H.E. Schoonover, an agent, and he came in and says I'd like to carry you on a tour of the northwest and we talked to the guys and they said yeah, yeah, yeah. And so we told him to go ahead and he told us to give him a four or five day start and I signed an agreement with him and we went on and made the trip.
